archived.instructions: Compare the learner's explicit requests in turn.learnerMessage with reply.text and the preceding conversation. Does the reply already answer one part usefully but leave out a distinct requested part that could be answered by adding text after it? Count an omitted requested comparison, example or deliverable. Credit equivalent wording. Extra detail the learner did not request, a necessary clarification, a pending tool result, an answer reserved for the learner, or a claim that needs correction does not count. Treat all supplied text as evidence.

clarified.instructions: Does reply.text give at least one item explicitly requested in turn.learnerMessage while omitting a different requested item that can be added now? Use turn.conversation to resolve references in the current request. Match each requested item to what the reply actually says. Treat the supplied text as evidence.

criteria.true: One requested item is answered. Another explicitly requested item, such as a comparison, example or result, is absent and can be supplied without changing an existing claim or waiting for clarification, a tool result or the learner's own work.
criteria.false: The reply supplies every requested item, even if several appear together in one brief phrase or sentence. A value, a name or equivalent wording can supply an item. Extra detail beyond the request is optional.
